title: Ladybug waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
      <!-- Ladybug body (shell) -->
      <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="26" ry="22" fill="#e63946" />
      
      <!-- Shell split line -->
      <line x1="50" y1="40" x2="50" y2="84" stroke="#b02a37" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      
      <!-- Shell spots (dark but lit slate) -->
      <circle cx="38" cy="55" r="4" fill="#2b2d42"/>
      <circle cx="62" cy="55" r="4" fill="#2b2d42"/>
      <circle cx="40" cy="72" r="3.5" fill="#2b2d42"/>
      <circle cx="60" cy="72" r="3.5" fill="#2b2d42"/>
      <circle cx="50" cy="65" r="3" fill="#2b2d42"/>
      
      <!-- Head -->
      <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="13" fill="#1b1d2e"/>
      
      <!-- Eyes (white with dark) -->
      <circle cx="45" cy="38" r="3.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
      <circle cx="55" cy="38" r="3.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
      <circle cx="45" cy="38.5" r="1.8" fill="#0f1020"/>
      <circle cx="55" cy="38.5" r="1.8" fill="#0f1020"/>
      
      <!-- Smile -->
      <path d="M45 45 Q50 49 55 45" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      
      <!-- Antennae -->
      <path d="M44 30 Q40 20 36 16" stroke="#1b1d2e" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M56 30 Q60 20 64 16" stroke="#1b1d2e" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <circle cx="36" cy="15" r="2.5" fill="#e63946"/>
      <circle cx="64" cy="15" r="2.5" fill="#e63946"/>
      
      <!-- Left arm (resting down) -->
      <path d="M30 58 Q22 62 20 70" stroke="#1b1d2e" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <circle cx="19" cy="72" r="2.5" fill="#1b1d2e"/>
      
      <!-- Right arm waving hello -->
      <path d="M70 56 Q78 48 80 38" stroke="#1b1d2e" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <circle cx="81" cy="36" r="3" fill="#1b1d2e"/>
      
      <!-- Waving motion lines -->
      <path d="M86 32 Q90 30 89 26" stroke="#ffd166" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M87 38 Q92 37 92 32" stroke="#ffd166" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      
      <!-- Legs -->
      <path d="M30 80 Q26 86 24 90" stroke="#1b1d2e" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M50 84 Q50 90 50 92" stroke="#1b1d2e" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M70 80 Q74 86 76 90" stroke="#1b1d2e" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </svg>
